dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "-m", "pytest"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt with pinned versions for pytest and lxml based on common compatibility with Python 3.9. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs dependencies from requirements.txt, copies the application code, and sets default command to run pytest tests.
